it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sembrano potenti. Fammi vedere.
\bEhi, ragazzino. Sta' lontano dal mio territorio.

id: \bSomeone is trying to steal our Eggs. Please help us out.
en: \bSomeone is trying to steal our Eggs. Please help us out.
it: \bQualcuno sta cercando di rubare le nostre Uova. Ti prego, aiutaci.

id: \bThank you so much for saving our Eggs. How would you like to take one as a gift?
en: \bThank you so much for saving our Eggs. How would you like to take one as a gift?
it: \bGrazie mille per aver salvato le nostre Uova. Che ne dici di prenderne una in regalo?

id: \bOh, you can't carry it with you.
en: \bOh, you can't carry it with you.

id: \bMake some space in your party and come back.
en: \bMake some space in your party and come back.
it: \bFai un po' di posto nella tua squadra e torna.

id: \bThe Egg will hatch into a Fire type. Though which one it is is a surprise.
en: \bThe Egg will hatch into a Fire type. Though which one it is is a surprise.
it: \bDall'Uovo nascerà un Pokémon di tipo Fuoco. Quale sarà, però, è una sorpresa.

id: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \rTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.

id: \rAh, looks like a challenging Trainer. Ready, Jes?
en: \rAh, looks like a challenging Trainer.  Ready, Jes?
it: \rAh, sembra un Allenatore impegnativo.  Ci sei, Jes?

id: \rSorry. I thought you were going to steal them.
en: \rSorry. I thought you were going to steal them.

id: \rMaybe I'm not cut out for this.
en: \rMaybe I'm not cut out for this.

id: \bYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \bYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.

id: \bI never catch anything. I don't need this.
en: \bI never catch anything. I don't need this.
it: \bNon catturo mai niente. Non ne ho bisogno.

id: \bLet's rock. Time to prove to my family I can do this.
en: \bLet's rock. Time to prove to my family I can do this.
it: \bSi parte. È ora di dimostrare alla mia famiglia che ce la posso fare.

id: \bI should get home to my wife and son.
en: \bI should get home to my wife and son.
it: \bDovrei tornare a casa da mia moglie e mio figlio.
